- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/verifiers/{verifier_id}/verifications` — Ask a wallet, by QR, to present what a form asks for, as one of the verifiers
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/verifiers/{verifier_id}/verifications/{verification_id}` — A verification: pending, answered with its verdict, or expired
- `GET /api/v1/verifications/{verification_id}/request` — The verifier's request, as the wallet reads it
- `POST /api/v1/verifications/{verification_id}/request/response` — The wallet's answer: a `vp_token` (OpenID4VP `direct_post`)
